historical_rules: cutoff = checkpoint boundary - 1 s; gold = changelog items strictly before the boundary
the asked field's latest visible change lies in the task window (from 2023-01-01); earlier changes of a history answer are in the complete stream
no issue appears twice; issues of every coding candidate are reserved for coding
keyless tasks name the issue by its summary as of the cutoff (unique among issues existing then) and its creation month; the key stays private

the families of families.py take GitHub/mail gold from the stream itself and JIRA gold from the raw changelog; strings are graded casefolded and whitespace-normalised, arrays sorted; keyless PR tasks name the PR by its (unique) title and opening month
relaxations: coding tasks are mapped to checkpoint 2023-02 regardless of their context cutoff
historical gold ignores nothing, but issues with a change of the asked field between the smoke stream end (2023-02-15) and the 2023-02 boundary are excluded
one task per family; keyless alternates by family
only the emitted coding tasks' issues (not every candidate's) are kept out of the historical half
test_patch_policy: The test patch is never shown to the agent (hidden tests, as in SWE-bench): the public record carries only `base_sha` and the `tests` the grader runs; the prompt names no test.
